title: Oswald's planned role and the killing of Officer Tippit

tellings.quote: the plan the plan was to Simply have have uh have Oswald take the shot at Kennedy yeah uh flee run away get away and have tipit uhhuh kill him

related.note: Both tell Sheehan's account of the plan for Oswald's shot and Tippit's role. Here Oswald shoots at Kennedy, while the story has a deliberate miss to blame Cuba.

plain: In Dallas in 1963, the plan was supposedly for Lee Harvey Oswald to shoot at Kennedy and run, and then for a Dallas police officer named J. D. Tippit to kill him. A guest named Dan Sheehan lays out this theory to Michels; elsewhere it is told with Oswald meant to miss on purpose so Cuba could be blamed. If true, it would mean Oswald was a planned fall guy for a larger plot.
